descriptionHtml:
Redragon H888 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Headset Black (Tri-Mode Connectivity: 2.4GHz Wireless / Bluetooth / 3.5mm Wired / Ultra Lightweight Ergonomic Design / Powerful Dynamic Drivers / Detachable Noise-Canceling Microphone / Soft Memory Foam Earpads / Multi-Platform Support / 1 Year Official Local Agent Warranty)

Experience versatile, lag-free audio performance with the Redragon H888 Tri-Mode Wireless Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty. Engineered with flexible Tri-Mode connection technology, it lets you seamlessly switch between low-latency 2.4GHz wireless for competitive gaming, Bluetooth for mobile convenience, and standard 3.5mm wired mode for universal console pairing. Designed with an ultra-lightweight frame and soft memory foam earpads, the H888 ensures pressure-free comfort during long gaming sessions while delivering clear spatial audio and crisp voice communication through its detachable noise-canceling microphone.
